The panel is leaning against a wall, with visible mounting brackets and wires attached to the frame.
The surface of the panel appears clean and intact, with no obvious cracks or damage.
The background includes a pink wall and a tiled floor, suggesting an outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
There is a watermark or text overlay on the image, partially obscuring the view of the panel.

risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or low-efficiency

risks.risk: The panel may not be genuine or may be a counterfeit, especially since the watermark obscures the view.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel, showing the brand, model, and wattage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded or generic, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel showing brand, model, and wattage.
Close-up photo of the panel's surface under bright light to check for microcracks or damage.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
